picture-pairs.name: Piyryn jalloo
picture-pairs.seoTitle: Gamman Co-reggyrtys son Dementia: Piyryn Jalloo
picture-pairs.description: Gamman co-reggyrtys mial as nastee son sleih ta beaghey lesh dementia. Ta jallooyn mooarey tannaghtyn ry-akin, cha nel oorydderey ny skoor ayn, as ta shiu reih eddyr 4 as 12 leac.
picture-pairs.short: Fow y daa yalloo ta gollrish y cheilley. Foddee ny jallooyn tannaghtyn ry-akin.
picture-pairs.intro: Broo er jalloo, as eisht broo er y fer ta gollrish. Ta ny jallooyn tannaghtyn ry-akin dy cadjin, myr shen cha nel feme erbee ayn dy chooinaghtyn nhee erbee. Tra ta daa yalloo goll ry-cheilley, t'ad geddyn oirr airh as cowrey kiart.
howTo: Reih cre whilleen leac lhisagh y ve ayn. Ta kiare leacyn nyn ynnyd kiune dy hoshee.
Broo er jalloo erbee. T'eh geddyn oirr airh.
Broo er y jalloo ta gollrish. Ta'n piyr tannaghtyn ry-cheilley marish cowrey kiart.
My ta'n daa yalloo anchasley, cha nel nhee erbee olk taghyrt. Broo reesht tra ta shiu aarloo.
Lhig da "Jallooyn follit" ve er tra ta shiu nyn ndeees carrey lesh y chummey cadjin er nyn oaieyn sheese.
tips: Enmys-jee ny jallooyn magh dy ard ry-cheilley as coloayrt my nyn gione: "Cappan tey jiarg. Vel shiu goaill bainney ayns nyn dey?"
Lhig da'n peiagh ta shiu cur kiarail da broo er ny jallooyn, eer my t'eh goaill tammylt. Pointeil ayns ynnyd jeh broo er nyn son.
Tannee marish kiare leacyn choud's t'eh maynrey. She reih t'ayn dy ghoaill tooilley leacyn, cha nel eh rieau ny cheim dy roshtyn.
Cur jerrey er choud's t'eh foast taitnyssagh. Ta un ghamman ny ymmyrch slane hene.

faq.q: Vel oorydderey ny skoor ayn?
faq.a: Cha nel. Cha nel clag, skoor, earrooder scughey ny cailjyn ayn. Foddee shiu scuirr ec traa erbee, as ta scuirr lieh-vollagh ny aght feer vie dy chur jerrey er.

faq.q: Cre'n fa ta ny jallooyn tannaghtyn er nyn oaieyn seose?
faq.a: Lesh freayll ny jallooyn ry-akin, ta'n gamman bentyn rish jeeaghyn as co-reggyrt ayns ynnyd jeh cooinaghtyn. S'kiuney lesh ram sleih eh shoh. Foddee shiu caghlaa dys jallooyn follit lesh un vroo my sailliu.

faq.q: Vel eh nastee, as vel feme aym er recortys?
faq.a: Ta, t'eh nastee, as cha nel coontys, recortys ny laadey neose ry-laccal. T'eh obbraghey ayns y vrowser eddyr-vwaill er chellvane, claare-screeuee ny co-earrooder.

faq.q: Vod mayd jannoo ymmyd jeh caslyssyn-shoilshey y lught-thie ain hene?
faq.a: Foddee. Jean prowaltys lesh Photo pairs, ta lhiggey diu reih caslyssyn-shoilshey voish y ghreie eu. Ta ny caslyssyn-shoilshey tannaghtyn ayns y vrowser eu as cha nel ad goll er laadey seose.

find-the-same.name: Fow y fer cheddin
find-the-same.seoTitle: Fow y Jalloo Cheddin: Gamman Aashagh son Dementia
find-the-same.description: Un yalloo ec y vullagh, daa dys kiare heese. Broo er y fer ta gollrish. Gamman jalloo kiune as nastee son sleih ta beaghey lesh dementia, gyn oorydderey.
find-the-same.short: Jeeagh er y jalloo ec y vullagh as broo er y fer cheddin heese.
find-the-same.intro: Ta un yalloo ny hoie ec mullagh y scaailan. Fo, ta daa, tree ny kiare jallooyn. Broo er y fer ta gollrish. She un reih aashagh ec un traa t'ayn, marish ram traa dy choloayrt.
howTo: Reih daa, tree ny kiare jallooyn dy reih voue. She daa y fer s'aashagh.
Jeeagh-jee er y jalloo ec y vullagh ry-cheilley.
Broo er y jalloo cheddin heese. T'eh er ny chowraghey lesh cowrey kiart as kuse dy ocklyn caarjoil.
My vees brooit er jalloo elley, cha nel y gamman agh cur ennym er as fuirraghtyn. Gow-jee nyn draa.
Broo er "Y nah yalloo" tra ta shiu aarloo son fer elley.
tips: Coloayrt-jee mychione dagh jalloo roish reih: daaghyn, cummaghyn, raad dy vodbar fakin eh.
Cha nel daa reih "ro aashagh". She taitnys y dean, cha nel doilleeid.
My ta broo doillee, foddee y peiagh pointeil as foddee shiuish broo er nyn son.

faq.q: Vel oorydderey ny skoor ayn?
faq.a: Cha nel. Cha nel clag, skoor, earrooder scughey ny cailjyn ayn. Foddee shiu scuirr ec traa erbee, as ta scuirr lieh-vollagh ny aght feer vie dy chur jerrey er.

faq.q: Cre ta taghyrt my vees brooit er y jalloo neuchiart?
faq.a: Cha nel nhee erbee neuhaitnyssagh taghyrt. Cha nel tharmane, crosh yiarg ny craa ayn. Ta'n gamman cur ennym er y jalloo va brooit as fuirraghtyn rish y nah vroo.

faq.q: Vel eh nastee, as vel feme aym er recortys?
faq.a: Ta, t'eh nastee, as cha nel coontys, recortys ny laadey neose ry-laccal. T'eh obbraghey ayns y vrowser eddyr-vwaill er chellvane, claare-screeuee ny co-earrooder.

shadow-match.name: Co-reggyrt scaadoo
shadow-match.seoTitle: Gamman Co-reggyrt Scaadoo son Dementia: Nastee er-voggyl
shadow-match.description: Scaadoo doo ec y vullagh, daa dys kiare jallooyn heese. Broo er y jalloo ta jannoo y scaadoo. Gamman co-reggyrt scaadoo kiune as nastee son dementia, gyn oorydderey.
shadow-match.short: Jeeagh er y scaadoo as broo er y jalloo ta jannoo eh.
shadow-match.intro: Ta co-reggyrt scaadoo ny obbyr chadjin voish duillagyn obbyr clouit, agh ayns shoh marish jallooyn mooarey as veg dy chlou. Ta scaadoo bog ny hoie ec mullagh y scaailan as daa, tree ny kiare jallooyn fuirraghtyn heese. Broo er y fer ta jannoo y scaadoo. T'eh aashagh dy choloayrt mychione cummaghyn myr roar, scaath-fliaghee ny cappan tey chammah.
howTo: Reih daa, tree ny kiare jallooyn dy reih voue. She daa y fer s'aashagh.
Jeeagh-jee er y scaadoo ry-cheilley. Cre'n cummey t'er? Vel eh ard ny cruinn?
Broo er y jalloo ta jannoo y scaadoo. Ta'n ennym echey ry-akin fo'n scaadoo.
My vees brooit er jalloo elley, cha nel y gamman agh cur ennym er as fuirraghtyn. Gow-jee nyn draa.
Broo er "Y nah scaadoo" tra ta shiu aarloo son fer elley.
tips: Lhiant-jee rish oirr y scaadoo lesh mair as coloayrt-jee mychione y chummey.
My ta ny scaadooghyn doillee jiu, caghlaa dys Fow y fer cheddin, raad ta ny jallooyn cosoylagh.
Coloayrt-jee mychione y jalloo lurg da v'er ny feddyn: "Va scaath-fliaghee gollrish shen ain hene."

faq.q: Vel oorydderey ny skoor ayn?
faq.a: Cha nel. Cha nel clag, skoor, earrooder scughey ny cailjyn ayn. Foddee shiu scuirr ec traa erbee, as ta scuirr lieh-vollagh ny aght feer vie dy chur jerrey er.

faq.q: Vel cormaghey scaaghyn mie da sleih ta beaghey lesh dementia?
faq.a: Foddee eh ve ny obbyr haitnyssagh, aashagh da kuse dy leih, ayns ny chied cheimyn er lheh. Ta cummaghyn ny sassey dy enn na focklyn. T'eh son taitnys as coloayrtys, cha nel eh ny phrowaltys, as cha nel eh lheeys ny moallaghey dementia. My t'eh cur corree erbee er peiagh erbee, prow Fow y fer cheddin ny jeeagh er jallooyn ry-cheilley dy aashagh.

faq.q: Cre ta taghyrt my vees crig er y drogh yalloo?
faq.a: Veg neuhaitnyssagh. Cha nel sheeaner, crosh ruy ny craa erbee ayn. Ta'n cloie cur ennym er y jalloo va criggit er as fuirraghtyn rish y nah chrig.

faq.q: Vel eh nastee, as vel feme aym er fo-screeu?
faq.a: Ta, t'eh nastee, as cha nel coontys, fo-screeu ny laadey neose erbee ayn. T'eh gobbraghey ayns y jeeagheyder-moghey er çhellvane, claare-screeuee ny co-earrooder.

sort-together.name: Sortey ry-cheilley
sort-together.seoTitle: Cloie Sortey son Dementia: Sortey Ry-cheilley
sort-together.description: Crig er jalloo, eisht crig er y vlastag t'eh bentyn rish: coagyrey ny garey, messyn ny beiyn. Obbyr hortey chiune, nastee son sleih ta beaghey lesh dementia.
sort-together.short: Cur dagh jalloo 'sy vlastag echey: coagyrey ny garey, as ny smoo.
sort-together.intro: Ta sortey ny obbyr chadjin, liauyr-chliaghtit gagh laa, gollrish cur stoo-shappee ersooyl ny kiangley oashyryn ayns piyryn. Crig er jalloo, eisht crig er y vlastag raad t'eh bentyn rish. Cha nel siyr erbee ayn as cha nel cassan aggairagh ayn.
howTo: Reih cooish: coagyrey as garey, messyn as beiyn, ny thie as marrinys.
Crig er jalloo. Hig oirr airhey er.
Crig er y vlastag t'eh bentyn rish. Ta'n jalloo gleashaghey stiagh 'sy vlastag shen.
My t'eh bentyn rish y vlastag elley, ta'n cloie gra shen dy meen as fuirraghtyn.
Tra vees dagh jalloo sortit, jeeagh trooid ny bastagyn ry-cheilley.
tips: Dy mennick cha nel answoryn aggairagh 'sy vea chiart. My t'ad gra dy vel canneen-ushtee bentyn rish y choagyrey, fow magh cre'n fa. Foddee dy gou skeeal vie.
Jean ymmyd jeh ny jallooyn son coloayrtys: «Cre v'ou gaase 'sy gharey ayds?»
Ta sortey reddyn firrinagh, lheid as speeinjyn as aayryn ny crammanyn rere daah, ny obbyr ard-yindyssagh jeant magh voish y fasteyr.

faq.q: Vel oorydd ny poyntyn ayn?
faq.a: Cha nel. Cha nel clag, poyntyn, coonteyder-gleashaght ny cailjey erbee ayn. Foddys oo scuirr ec traa erbee, as ta scuirr lieh-vollagh ny aght feer vie dy chur kione er.

faq.q: Cre'n fa sortey?
faq.a: Ta ram sleih goaill taitnys ayns sortey er-yn-oyr dy vel eh goaill er lheid as obbyr ymmydoil, chliaghtit. T'eh aashagh myrgeddin dy loayrt mychione ny jallooyn tra t'ou goll er oaie.

faq.q: Vel eh nastee, as vel feme aym er fo-screeu?
faq.a: Ta, t'eh nastee, as cha nel coontys, fo-screeu ny laadey neose erbee ayn. T'eh gobbraghey ayns y jeeagheyder-moghey er çhellvane, claare-screeuee ny co-earrooder.

picture-puzzle.name: Feysht jalloo
picture-puzzle.seoTitle: Meeley Jalloo Aashagh son Dementia: 4 ny 9 Meeryn
picture-puzzle.description: Meeley jalloo eddyrvhoggyl aashagh son sleih ta beaghey lesh dementia: 4 ny 9 meeryn mooarey, ta'n slane jalloo tannaghtyn ry-akin, as t'ou criggagh er daa veer dy chaghlaa ad.
picture-puzzle.short: Crig er daa veer dy chaghlaa ad derrey vees y jalloo slane.
picture-puzzle.intro: Ta jalloo caarjoil giarit ayns kiare ny nuy meeryn mooarey as laadit ry-cheilley. Ta'n slane jalloo tannaghtyn ry-akin myr leeideilys. Crig er un veer, eisht er fer elley, as t'ad caghlaa ynnydyn. Cha nel feme er tayrn erbee.
howTo: Reih jalloo as 4 ny 9 meeryn. Ta kiare ny hoshiaght veen.
Jeeagh er y slane jalloo ec y vullagh.
Crig er meer, eisht crig er yn ynnyd raad lhisagh eh goll. Ta'n daa veer caghlaa.
Ta meeryn 'syn ynnyd chiart geddyn cowrey kiart beg.
Tra vees y jalloo slane, gow-jee taitnys ass ry-cheilley, eisht reih fer elley.
tips: Ta criggagh er daa veer dy chaghlaa ad ny sassey dy vooar na tayrn da ram sleih.
Loayr mychione y jalloo tra t'eh çheet ry-cheilley: «Shen y kione-thie jiarg.»
Ta meeley maidjey firrinagh lesh 12 dys 24 meeryn mooarey ny obbyr voandey er y voayrd myrgeddin.

faq.q: Vel oorydd ny poyntyn ayn?
faq.a: Cha nel. Cha nel clag, poyntyn, coonteyder-gleashaght ny cailjey erbee ayn. Foddys oo scuirr ec traa erbee, as ta scuirr lieh-vollagh ny aght feer vie dy chur kione er.

faq.q: Vel feme aym er tayrn ny meeryn?
faq.a: Cha nel. Crig er un veer, eisht crig er fer elley, as t'ad caghlaa ynnydyn. T'eh shoh ny sassey lesh laue chraaee ny er fasteyr beg.

faq.q: Vel eh nastee, as vel feme aym er fo-screeu?
faq.a: Ta, t'eh nastee, as cha nel coontys, fo-screeu ny laadey neose erbee ayn. T'eh gobbraghey ayns y jeeagheyder-moghey er çhellvane, claare-screeuee ny co-earrooder.

finish-the-saying.name: Cur kione er y raa
finish-the-saying.seoTitle: Cur Kione er y Raa: Cloie Shenn-Raaghyn son Shenn-Sleih
finish-the-saying.description: Shenn-raaghyn cadjin as yn fockle s'jerree er faagail magh, lheid as «Ta ping sauilt ny ping ___». Crig er reih ny taishbyn y jerrey, eisht loayr mychione.
finish-the-saying.short: Cur-jee kione er shenn-raaghyn cadjin ry-cheilley, eisht loayr-jee my nyn gione.
finish-the-saying.intro: Dy mennick ta shenn-raaghyn er enney mie feie nyn mea. Ta dagh caart taishbyney shenn-raa cadjin as yn fockle s'jerree er faagail magh, tree reihyn, as cramman «Taishbyn y jerrey». Lurg y jerrey, ta feysht veen cur cuirrey da coloayrtys.
howTo: Lhaih-jee yn raa magh ard ry-cheilley.
Crig er y vockle ta cur kione er, ny crig er «Taishbyn y jerrey».
Lhaih-jee yn slane raa reesht as loayr-jee mychione lesh cooney y cheisht.
Crig er «Y nah raa» tra vees shiu aarloo.
tips: Lhaih dy moal as lhig da aash roish y vockle s'jerree. Dy mennick ta sleih gra eh roish my vel oo er chur kione er.
My vees fer ennagh cur jerrey elley er, gow taitnys ass. Ta cummaghyn er lheh ec kuse dy raaghyn rere lught-thie ny ard.
Ayns possan, ta un pheersoon lhaih as ta dagh peiagh goaill ayrn 'sy jerrey.

faq.q: Vel oorydd ny poyntyn ayn?
faq.a: Cha nel. Cha nel clag, skor, coonteyder bioyraghey ny cailltys erbee ayn. Foddys oo scuirr ec traa erbee, as she aght feer vie eh dy chur jerrey lesh lieh-raad.

faq.q: Cre my reihys mayd fockle elley?
faq.a: Ta'n cloie taishbyney yn kione cadjin as goll er oaie dys coloayrtys. Cha nel skor erbee ayn, as s'mie yn red eh freggyrt elley.

faq.q: Vel eh nastee, as vel feme aym er recortys y yannoo?
faq.a: Ta, t'eh nastee, as cha nel coontey, recortys ny laadey neose erbee ry yannoo. T'eh gobbraghey 'sy jeeagheyder eddyr-vleeantyn er giare-çhellvane, taiblit ny co-earrooder.

word-search.name: Ronsee fockle clou mooar
word-search.seoTitle: Ronsee Fockle Clou Mooar ry hoi Mee-Chuimhne, So-Chlou
word-search.description: Ronsee fockle nastee ayns clou mooar ry hoi shenn sleih as sleih ta beaghey lesh mee-chuimhne. Beggan focklyn, lettyryn mooarey, focklyn tessen as sheese ny lomarcan. Cloie er-linney ny clou eh.
word-search.short: Lettyryn mooarey, beggan focklyn, tessen as sheese ny lomarcan. Clou eh neesht.
word-search.intro: Grillee beg lesh lettyryn mooarey as cha nel agh lane laue dy 'ocklyn, dagh fer jeu ry lhaih tessen ny sheese. Crig er kied lettyr y 'ockle, eisht er yn eiyrtysagh echey. Bare lhiat pabyr? Clou keintys noa lesh un chriggey.
howTo: Reih kione-fockle as mooadys y ghagrane.
Jeeagh er rolley ny focklyn. Ta focklyn ry lhaih tessen (veih'n chiare dys y yesh) ny sheese (veih'n vullagh dys y bun).
Crig er kied lettyr fockle, eisht crig er y lettyr s'jerree echey.
Tra t'ou feddyn fockle, t'eh goll er soilshey as tayrn lhiattee jeh'n rolley.
Crig er "Clou yn puzzyl shoh" dy chloie er pabyr lesh penn-leoie ny penn-markee.
tips: Cur dty vair er fockle 'sy rolley as lhaih-jee son y chied lettyr echey ry-cheilley.
Er pabyr, s'aashagh eh dy reayll soilsheyder na penn-leoie.
Loayr-jee mychione focklyn y chione-chooid. Ta focklyn measagh nyn saase najooragh dys cooinaghtyn er spiyrt, fuinney ny margey.

faq.q: Vel ooryssag ny skor ayn?
faq.a: Cha nel. Cha nel clag, skor, coonteyder bioyraghey ny cailltys erbee ayn. Foddys oo scuirr ec traa erbee, as she aght feer vie eh dy chur jerrey lesh lieh-raad.

faq.q: Noddym clou y ronsee fockle?
faq.a: Noddys. Crig er "Clou yn puzzyl shoh" dy chlou yn grillee roie ayns clou mooar, lesh rolley ny focklyn fo. Ta dagh puzzyl noa anchasley.

faq.q: Vel eh nastee, as vel feme aym er recortys y yannoo?
faq.a: Ta, t'eh nastee, as cha nel coontey, recortys ny laadey neose erbee ry yannoo. T'eh gobbraghey 'sy jeeagheyder eddyr-vleeantyn er giare-çhellvane, taiblit ny co-earrooder.

coloring.name: Duillagyn daah
coloring.seoTitle: Duillagyn Daah ry hoi Sleih Aasit lesh Mee-Chuimhne (Nastee)
coloring.description: Duillagyn daah aashagh ry hoi sleih aasit lesh cryssyn mooarey: crig er daah, eisht crig er y chochaslys. Gyn ribbey, gyn daah carragh, as foddear dagh duillag y chlou nastee.
coloring.short: Crig er daah, eisht er ayrn jeh'n chochaslys. Clou duillagyn neesht.
coloring.intro: Duillagyn lesh cummaghyn mooarey, aashagh: blaa ayns pash, thie, cappan tee, follican as baatey-shiaull. Crig er daah, eisht crig er ayrn jeh'n chochaslys dy lioney eh. Cha nel daah carragh erbee ayn.
howTo: Reih duillag.
Crig er daah. Ta ennym dagh daah screeuit er.
Crig er ayrn jeh'n chochaslys dy lioney eh lesh y daah shen.
Ceaghil dty aigney ec traa erbee liorish lioney eh reesht.
Crig er "Clou yn duillag shoh" son duillag vane dy ghaaghey lesh pennyn-leoie daah ny pennyn-markee.
tips: Cur daa ghaah dy reih jeh ayns ynnyd y çhymsaght slane my vees eh ro-yientagh.
Ta croieyn gorrym-jiarg as greinyn gorrym feer failt. T'eh shoh mychione goaill soylley jeh daah, cha nel kiartys.
Ta duillagyn clouit gobbraghey dy mie lesh pennyn-markee çhiu ny crayonyryn, as t'ad ny s'aashagh dy ghlackey.

faq.q: Vel ooryssag ny skor ayn?
faq.a: Cha nel. Cha nel clag, skor, coonteyder bioyraghey ny cailltys erbee ayn. Foddys oo scuirr ec traa erbee, as she aght feer vie eh dy chur jerrey lesh lieh-raad.

faq.q: Vel ny duillagyn shoh ro lhiannooagh?
faq.a: Ren shin tayrn reddyn sheeoil, aashagh ayns ynnyd cochaslyssyn aitt, myr shen t'ad cooie da sleih aasit. Ta cummaghyn mooarey freayll daaghey aashagh gyn cur er dy ve myr cloie paitçhey.

faq.q: Vel eh nastee, as vel feme aym er recortys y yannoo?
faq.a: Ta, t'eh nastee, as cha nel coontey, recortys ny laadey neose erbee ry yannoo. T'eh gobbraghey 'sy jeeagheyder eddyr-vleeantyn er giare-çhellvane, taiblit ny co-earrooder.

conversation-cards.name: Kaartyn coloayrtys
conversation-cards.seoTitle: Fosley Coloayrtys ry hoi Mee-Chuimhne: Kaartyn Cochaslys
conversation-cards.description: Kaartyn cochaslys lesh toshiaghtyn aashagh da coloayrtys ry hoi sleih ta beaghey lesh mee-chuimhne: gyn feyshtey, gyn freggyrt kiart erbee. Ymmyd er scaailan ny clou yn slane çhymsaght.
conversation-cards.short: Kaartyn cochaslys lesh feyshtyn foshlit, meeley. Gyn feyshtey.
conversation-cards.intro: Ta dagh kaart cur cochaslys cadjin marish cuirrey foshlit dy loayrt, myr "Cre'n sort emshir s'reaie lhiat?" Cha nel freggyrt kiart erbee ayn as cha nel red erbee dy chooinaghtyn er. Reih kione-chooid ny mest ad ooilley ry-cheilley.
howTo: Reih kione-chooid, ny freill "Dagh kaart".
Lhaih yn feysht magh as jeeagh-jee er y chochaslys ry-cheilley.
Eisht, rheynn dty 'reggyrt hene, as lhig da'n chooish goll er oaie.
Crig er "Y chied chaart elley" tra t'ou aarloo, ny tannys lesh un chaart choud's saillt.
Crig er "Clou dagh kaart" dy yannoo çhymsaght phabyr lesh giarrey.
tips: Freggyr yn feysht oo hene neesht. T'eh gollrish coloayrtys, cha nel feyshtey.
Eiyr er y skeeal, cha nel ny feer-oyryn. My vees recortysyn ceaghlit, s'mie shen.
My vees kaart bwoalley er red trimshagh, cur enney er y ventyr as immee dy meigh dys kaart elley.

faq.q: Cre'n fa nagh vel feyshtyn "Vel cooinaghtyn ayd er…?" ayn?
faq.a: Foddys feyshtyn ta prowail cooinaghtyn gollrish scrutaght as cur nearey er peiagh. Ta cuirraghyn foshlit myr "Insh dou mychione…" lhiggey da peiagh erbee çheet stiagh, cre erbee ta ayns nyn gooinaghtyn.

faq.q: Noddym clou ny kaartyn?
faq.a: Noddys. Ta "Clou dagh kaart" clou yn slane çhymsaght ayns clou mooar, shiartanse dy chaartyn er dagh duillag, aarloo dy ghiarey magh.

faq.q: Vel eh nastee, as vel feme aym er recortys y yannoo?
faq.a: She, t'eh nastee, as cha nel coontys, recortaghey ny laadey neose erbee ry-laccal. T'eh gobbraghey 'sy vrowser-wib er çhellvane, claare-screeuee ny co-earrooder.

photo-pairs.name: Piyryn jalloo
photo-pairs.seoTitle: Jean Cloie Co-reggyrtys ass Caslyssyn-Soilshey y Lught-Thie
photo-pairs.h1: Piyryn Jalloo: Jean Co-reggyrtys lesh ny Caslyssyn-Soilshey Eu Hene
photo-pairs.description: Chymmlidys ny caslyssyn-soilshey lught-thie eu hene gys cloie co-reggyrtys meein. Reih 2 gys 6 caslyssyn-soilshey er yn saase eu; t'ad tannaghtyn 'sy vrowser eu as cha nel ad rieau laadit seose.
photo-pairs.short: Reih ny caslyssyn-soilshey eu hene as jean co-reggyrtys orroo. Cha nel nhee erbee laadit seose.
photo-pairs.intro: Reih eddyr daa as shey caslyssyn-soilshey voish y çhellvane, claare-screeuee ny co-earrooder eu, as t'ad çheet dy ve nyn gloie co-reggyrtys lesh jallooyn mooarey, so-akin. Cha nel ny caslyssyn-soilshey ry-akin agh çheusthie jeh'n duillag shoh. Cha nel ad laadit seose, sauailt ny rheynnit, as t'ad goll ass traa ta shiu dooney yn duillag.
howTo: Crig er "Reih caslyssyn-soilshey" as reih eddyr daa as shey caslyssyn-soilshey.
Ta dagh caslys-soilshey ry-akin daa cheayrt. Crig er fer, as eisht crig er e phiyr.
Loow mychione dagh caslys-soilshey traa ta shiu feddyn eh.
Traa ta shiu jeant, doon y duillag ny crig er "Glen caslyssyn-soilshey". Cha nel nhee erbee freilt.
tips: Reih caslyssyn-soilshey baghtal jeh reddyn maynrey, cadjin: peata, garey, boayl s'dooie, laa poosee.
Foddee dy vel jallooyn jeh buill as reddyn ny s'aashagh na eddynyn, as t'ad shaghney broo erbee dy enmys sleih.
Faag magh caslyssyn-soilshey jeh sleih ta marroo my foddee ad cur sneih doolaneagh, mannagh vel fys eu dy vel ad cur gerjagh.

faq.q: Vel ny caslyssyn-soilshey aym laadit seose boayl erbee?
faq.a: Cha nel. Ta'n duillag lhaih ny caslyssyn-soilshey ta shiu reih dy jeeragh 'sy vrowser eu as ta'n duillag taishbyney ad er y scaailan eu. Cha nel ad currit dooin ny da peiagh erbee elley, as t'ad ersooyl traa ta shiu dooney ny aalaadey yn duillag.

faq.q: Vel traa-reilleyder ny skoor ayn?
faq.a: Cha nel. Cha nel clag, skoor, coontaghey caghlaa-ynnyd ny cailltys erbee ayn. Foddee shiu scuirr ec traa erbee, as ta scuirr lieh-vollagh ny aght feer vie dy chur kione er.

faq.q: Noddym sauail y cloie da'n nah cheayrt?
faq.a: Cha nod 'sy vrowser, er currym, liorish shen cha nel nhee preevaadjagh erbee stoyrit. Foddee yn app nastee Golden Moments son iPhone as iPad freill coipyn jeh ny caslyssyn-soilshey reiht er yn saase eu.

picture-bingo.name: Bingo jallooyn
picture-bingo.seoTitle: Bingo Jallooyn son Shenn-Sleih lesh Dementia: So-chlou
picture-bingo.description: Bingo jallooyn so-chlou nastee son kiarail cooinaghtyn as possanyn shenn-sleih, lesh eamerey mooar er y scaailan. Jallooyn mooarey lesh focklyn, 9 ny 16 kerrinyn, gyn femblaght er lhaih.
picture-bingo.short: Kaartyn bingo jallooyn so-chlou as eamerey er scaailan mooar son possanyn.
picture-bingo.intro: Bingo cadjin lesh jallooyn ayns ynnyd earrooyn, myr shen cha nel feme er peiagh erbee dy lhaih clou beg. Clou possan jeh kaartyn er-lheh, eisht jean ymmyd jeh'n eamerey er y scaailan dy haishbyney dagh jalloo dy mooar er çhellveeish, co-earrooder glioon ny claare-screeuee.
howTo: Reih 9 ny 16 kerrinyn er dagh kaart as cre cho mooar as ta'n earroo dy chloiederyn.
Crig er "Clou kaartyn". Ta dagh kaart anchasley.
Foshil yn eamerey er scaailan mooar. Crig er "Nah yalloo" dy haishbyney dagh jalloo marish e ennym.
Ta cloiederyn coodaghey yn jalloo co-reggyrtagh er y chaart oc lesh peesh-argid, cramman ny cowreyder.
Ta dagh fer ta lhieeney straih, ny yn kaart er-fey-ny-hoie, cosney ard-yindys. Cha nel caillee erbee 'sy lhieggan shoh: caghlaa cloie derrey ta linnagh ec dagh peiagh.
tips: Jean ymmyd jeh cowraghyn mooarey lheid as peeshyn dammey ny bayrnyn boteil. Foddee dy vel crammanyn beggey doillee dy hroggal.
Enmys y jalloo as loow red ennagh mychione: "Baatey-shiaull. Quoi t'er ve magh er baatey?"
Cur sleih ta doilleeid fakin oc ny s'faggys da'n scaailan, as jean piyryn jeh cooneydee marish cloiederyn ta feme oc orroo.
Ta nuy kerrinyn dy liooar son y chooid smoo jeh possanyn. Freill y çhymsaght mysh 20 gys 30 minnidyn.

faq.q: Kys ta mee stiurey bingo jallooyn ayns thie kiarail?
faq.a: Clou un chaart son dagh cloieder, cur yn eamerey er y scaailan smoo t'eu, as eam ny jallooyn dy moal, enmys dagh fer. Cloie derrey ta linnagh ec dagh peiagh, myr shen cha nel peiagh erbee faagit mooie.

faq.q: Vel eh nastee dy chlou?
faq.a: She. Clou whilleen kaartyn as ta feme eu orroo, cha mennick as sailliu, son ymmyd persoonagh ny possan.

faq.q: Nod sleih cloie gyn lhaih?
faq.a: She. Ta dagh kerrin ny yalloo mooar, marish e ennym fo son adsyn s'taitnys lioroo focklyn.

calm-breathing.name: Ennalaghey kiune
calm-breathing.seoTitle: Fastee Ennalagh Kiune son Shenn-Sleih as Kiarailtyssee
calm-breathing.description: Fastee ennalagh moal, kiune dy rheynn: ta kiarkyl meein gaase as leodaghey son shey tayrtyn ennal. Ta shiu goaill toshiaght er, as foddee shiu scuirr ec traa erbee.
calm-breathing.short: Kiarkyl moal dy ghoaill ennal marish. Gow toshiaght as scuirr traa sailliu.
calm-breathing.intro: Ny keayrtyn she fastee kiune yn obbyr share. Crig er "Gow toshiaght", eisht tayrn stiagh nyn n-ennal traa ta'n kiarkyl gaase as lhig magh nyn n-ennal traa t'eh leodaghey. Reih bieauid ny s'melley ny ny s'tappee. Cha nel eh ny lheeys, agh traa sheeoil dy rheynn.
howTo: Soie dy soccaragh lhiattee ry lhiattee.
Reih bieauid: moal ny meein.
Crig er "Gow toshiaght". Tayrn stiagh nyn n-ennal traa ta'n kiarkyl gaase, as lhig magh nyn n-ennal traa t'eh leodaghey.
T'eh scuirr liorish hene lurg shey tayrtyn ennal, ny crig er "Scuirr" traa erbee sailliu.
tips: Glack laueyn ny cur laue er roih yn dooinney my vel shen so-oltallagh.
Ny jean eginaghey rieau. My sailliu ny smoo fakin, ta shen mie dy liooar.
My ta doilleeidyn ennal ec peiagh erbee, gow ennal dy cadjin as jeeagh er y chiarkyl ynrican. Loow rish fer-lhee mychione imnea ennal erbee.

faq.q: Vel shoh cliaghtey ennalagh lheeysagh?
faq.a: Cha nel. She fastee aashagh, reihyssagh t'ayn son kiuney as sheshaght. Cha nel eh ny lheeys son imnea ny stayd erbee. Loow rish fer-lhee mychione imneaghyn slaynt.

faq.q: Vel y kiarkyl gleashaghey gyn mee dy ghoaill toshiaght er?
faq.a: Cha nel. Cha nel veg gleashaghey derrey nee oo broo er Toshiaght, as t'eh scuirr lurg shey ennalyn ny tra nee oo broo er Scuirr. My ta dty ghreie soiit dy leodaghey gleashaght, ta ny focklyn caghlaa gyn y kiarkyl gaase.

faq.q: Vel eh nastee, as vel feme aym er recortey?
faq.a: Ta, t'eh nastee, as cha nel coontys, recortys, ny laadey neose erbee ayn. T'eh gobbraghey ayns y ronseyder eddyr-voggyl er çhellvane, tablet ny co-earrooder.
